subject: per-phy-u-fund
title: PER.PHY.U.FUND.------SPT.DYM.
description: Chart on book p. 487 (MP(II)-5). PER-PHY-U-FUND (perceived physical universe fundamental) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; SPT-DYM (spiritual dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: RIT-DY (ritual dynamics) and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From RIT-DY: AFTD (affinity tendencies). From PROG-CONT: RT-ALGN (reality alignment). From AFTD: POST (postulation). From RT-ALGN: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) and APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions). From SOC-RT-DY: LANG-DY (language dynamics).
